# Vietnamese lunar calendar engine

Astronomy, types, and date representation modules (trailing whitespace normalized; algorithm unchanged) from
https://github.com/hnthap/lunar-calendar-api
Commit: 6e7dbc7c091d958095dcd3b0b8deadd556a05d7a
License: MIT (see LICENSE), copyright 2026 Huynh Nhan Thap.
Selected from https://github.com/topics/vietnamese-calendar.

Only the dependency-free conversion engine is included; Express and external API
hosting are not used. The application fixes the calendar timezone to UTC+7.
